lines.text: The first and greatest commandment is to love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul and mind.
The second is to love your neighbor as yourself, and all the Law and the Prophets hang on both.
Jesus asked the Pharisees whose son the Christ is, then quoted David saying, “Sit at My left hand.”
Jesus asked how the Christ could be David's son, and no one could answer or dared follow Him further.
